issues.description: A checked proof function retains an `axiom_` name instead of the required `lemma_` prefix.
issues.rationale: The function has a checked proof body, but its name still advertises an axiom/trusted fact. The same-commit AGENTS.md naming rule requires proof lemmas to use `lemma_` and axioms to use `axiom_`. The next commit renames it to `lemma_kernel_range_valid`, directly confirming the issue.
issues.source_evidence:
after/ostd/src/mm/kspace/kvirt_area.rs
263: pub proof fn axiom_kernel_range_valid(r: core::ops::Range<Vaddr>)

after/AGENTS.md
31: prefix proof lemmas using `lemma_` ... prefix axioms using `axiom_`
issues.verification: source-only; historical Verus not executed. Independently checked the same-commit naming rule, fixed source, and immediate rename commit.
